map_readings.label: Incomappleux River FSR Road Deactivation Prescription Map Section 2
map_readings.shows: Map title. A table beside it lists Road Section 'Section 2' with Length (m) '7266m' and 'Section 2 (to be surveyed)' with '6412m'. No km labels are printed on the road.

map_readings.label: WP 2-1 = POC Start of deactivation survey for Section 2
map_readings.shows: Green triangle (legend: Point of Commencement (POC)) where the green line (legend: To Be Surveyed in 2026) meets the orange line (legend: Deactivation Prescription).

map_readings.label: Deactivation Prescription
map_readings.shows: Legend entry for the orange line drawn along the road from WP 2-1 through WP 2-19, the stretch with prescribed deactivation works (cross ditches, culvert removals, pullbacks, bridge removal).

map_readings.label: To Be Surveyed in 2026
map_readings.shows: Legend entry for the green line drawn along the road beyond WP 2-1, the part of Section 2 still to be surveyed.

map_readings.label: WP 2-6 = BRIDGE/RB/RNSC LEXINGTON CREEK. Remove bridge and restore natural stream channel. Bridge is NOT passable Wet crossing required on high side. 1.5 hrs of machine time expected to create crossing.
map_readings.shows: Red X symbol (legend: Bridge Removal) on the road at Lexington Creek; the callout says the bridge is not passable.

map_readings.label: WP 2-3 = PFH - start
map_readings.shows: Callout marking the start of a full pullback section along a 40m long section of road; callout WP 2-4 = PFH - end marks its end.

map_readings.label: WP 2-13 = PFL
map_readings.shows: Callout marking a 3/4 pullback; callout WP 2-14 = PFL marks the end of pullback.

map_readings.label: December 12, 2025
map_readings.shows: Date printed in the map information block under the coordinate system and datum notes, above the Pioneer Forest Consulting Ltd. logo.
